Complementarities to Qual SD modelling:
Generally only cause–effect logic is used in SD
modelling, similar to the main chain of causes
and effects in TOC diagrams. However, both NC
and SC logic used in the TOC trees and EC
would provide very powerful complements to
the traditional ways of thinking in SD, helping to
surface assumptions and conditions needed for
relationships to hold that would often remain
unrecognised in SD models

Purpose and logic used (SC/NC):
To identify the problem symptoms and issues that
signal a need for change
Complementarities to Qual SD modelling:
Useful alternative way to generate relevant
variables for the CLD and to assist in defining the
problem or issue for SD modelling, separating
out symptoms (effects) from causes

Purpose and logic used (SC/NC): Provides a strategic map of destination (NC)
Complementarities to Qual SD modelling:
Assists SD modellers to think about and identify
the wider goals of the system the CLD/SD model
is constructed for (or contained within)

Purpose and logic used (SC/NC):
To identify critical root causes of current issues.
Includes assumptions and conditions for C–E
relationships to exist (SC)
Complementarities to Qual SD modelling:
Assists with identifying and developing the
pairwise relationships between the variables in a
CLD or Stock and Flow Diagram (SFD).
Draws attention to assumptions and conditions
needed for cause–effect (C–E) links to exist
which are generally missing in a CLD.
Focuses on addressing what is wrong with the
system, so much more focused than CLD

Purpose and logic used (SC/NC):
To resolve dilemmas/conflicts by clearly depicting
both sides’needs and underlying assumptions,
thereby prompting potential win–win solutions (NC)
Complementarities to Qual SD modelling:
A powerful method to assist SD modellers with
analysing and solving specific conflicts between
major stakeholder groups. Complements the
Group Model Building process in SD
Highlights key role of leverage points while
acknowledging the dilemmas inherent in taking
actions at those points. Provides targeted
questions for identifying solutions

Purpose and logic used (SC/NC):
To test the solution will eliminate or significantly
reduce the UDEs (SC)
Complementarities to Qual SD modelling:
A rigorous method of assisting SD modellers to
test solutions or policy interventions generated
by the EC process or from identifying leverage
points and CLD feedback loop analysis.
Helps focus required interventions (based on
primary and supporting injections)

Purpose and logic used (SC/NC):
Used when building the FRT to identify potential
negative side effects that may arise from the new
solution, and mitigate their effects (SC)
Complementarities to Qual SD modelling:
Prompts SD modellers to think about the
potential negative effects or unintended
consequences that may arise when suggesting a
policy intervention from traditional CLD
analysis.
